author: Julia Evans - Entertainment Editor
title: Trump calls Epstein files 'irrelevant' as Massie petition picks up steam
text:
trump Dismisses Epstein Controversy as⁣ “ Democrat Hoax ” Amid Push for ⁣Document Release Washington D.C. – President Donald Trump ⁢ on Wednesday downplayed the ongoing controversy surrounding​ the⁣ late Jeffrey Epstein, labeling efforts to compel the release of related documents a “democrat‌ hoax.” his comments came as survivors of Epstein’s​ abuse joined with members of​ Congress to demand greater transparency from the Justice Department.
When questioned by reporters in the Oval Office, Trump asserted the issue was “totally irrelevant to the success that​ we’ve had as a nation as I’ve been president.” He claimed, “From what I understand, thousands ⁣of pages of documents have been given,” but dismissed the calls for further disclosure as politically motivated.
The push‍ for full transparency centers on unreleased files related to Epstein’s crimes and potential connections to powerful individuals. A group of survivors recently met with House members to advocate for a vote forcing the Justice Department to release the withheld records.
Reacting to Trump’s characterization, survivors expressed dismay. (Details of their reaction from ABC News Capitol Hill Correspondent Jay O’Brien are forthcoming.)
The controversy surrounding Epstein continues to fuel scrutiny and demands for accountability, despite the former financier’s death in jail⁢ in 2019.⁢ The ongoing debate highlights the persistent questions surrounding his network and the extent of potential‌ complicity.
Keywords: Donald Trump, Jeffrey Epstein, Epstein‌ Documents, Democrat Hoax, Justice Department, Survivors, Congress, Transparency, Abuse, Oval ⁤Office, Washington D.C.
